Sort: compound_chembl_id ASC
Limit: none
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT d.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, d.pref_name AS compound_name, d.max_phase AS max_phase, d.molecule_type AS type, s.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles
FROM molecule_dictionary d
INNER JOIN compound_records r ON d.molregno = r.molregno
INNER JOIN compound_structures s ON r.molregno = s.molregno
INNER JOIN docs ON r.doc_id = docs.doc_id
WHERE docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1130277'
ORDER BY compound_chembl_id ASC;
